prompt_en: Create a photorealistic vertical 3:4 environmental fashion photograph at a tidal observatory just before dawn. One unmistakably adult woman whose facial and general appearance follows the provided portrait reference occupies about eighty-eight percent of the frame, seen head-to-toe at eye level. Her long dark wavy hair is swept behind both shoulders. She calibrates a tripod-mounted optical tide-gauge instrument on her right, turning its side control while her torso faces forward. The tripod, readout, reference staff, and her hands stay beside or below her ribcage, leaving an uninterrupted sightline across her neck and shirt front. Calibration markings appear as tiny defocused hash marks that function as texture rather than legible text. She wears a button-down collar shirt; matte ivory crisp poplin shirt and deep navy tailored trousers create a clean field-technician uniform against the mist. Tight plain-weave poplin catches pale cyan edge light in sharp dry folds around the collar and placket. Matte ivory collar fasteners remain isolated against a shadowless upper chest for immediate inspection. Stage the shirt so a complete center-front button placket remains visible from the collar stand to the tucked waist; two pointed collar tips remain separately readable and symmetrically frame the uncovered neck; one small button fastens each collar point, with two distinct collar-point buttons plainly visible; both collar tips visibly attach to the shirt body as the point buttons pass through collar-tip buttonholes; and a generic button-up placket does not substitute for collar fastening; the paired point-button attachments carry the distinction. The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame. Soft frontal cyan fill and a faint red rim reveal woven fibers, wet metal, sea mist, and real skin texture. Use the portrait solely for facial and general appearance continuity, without a biometric identity claim.
